# Online Zoning Map {.appendix}
This is an online version of the Cortland, Nebraska Zoning Map. It is intended for supplemental use. If there is a conflict between this map and the official zoning map, it is assumed that the official map is correct.

```{r Viz Zoning}
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| echo: false
#| eval: !expr knitr::is_html_output()

zoning <- cortland %>%
  mutate(
    Zoning = case_when(
      zoning == "ag" ~ "AG-1",
      zoning == "ag2" ~ "AG-2",
      zoning == "r1" ~ "R-1",
      zoning == "r2" ~ "R-2",
      zoning == "r3" ~ "R-3",
      zoning == "c1" ~ "C-1",
      zoning == "c2" ~ "C-2",
      zoning == "i" ~ "I",
      zoning == "uz" ~ "Unzoned"
    ) %>%
      factor(
        x = .,
        levels = c(
          "AG-1",
          "AG-2",
          "R-1",
          "R-2",
          "R-3",
          "C-1",
          "C-2",
          "I",
          "Unzoned"
        )
      )
  ) %>%
  select(PID, Zoning)

mapview::mapview(
  zoning,
  zcol = "Zoning",
  map.types = c("CartoDB.Positron", "Esri.WorldImagery"),
  col.regions = c(
    "#A3FF73",
    "#38A800",
    "#FF7F7F",
    "#FF0000",
    "#A80000",
    "#73FFDF",
    "#005CE6",
    "#FFAA00",
    "#BEC8D1"
  ),
  alpha.regions = c(0.50),
  lwd = 1.5,
  layer.name = "Zoning"
)
```
